title: View and edit permission rules from the Claude pane
notes: Claude Code: /permissions views and edits allow/ask/deny rules. SDK: list_permission_rules (sdk.d.ts:4873) is internal; updateSettings allowlist is narrow (3049). Pane: rules come only from "do not ask again" (chat-permission.ts:48). If not feasible through the SDK, comment on the card and stop without a PR. Size M.

comments.body: Skipped, SDK 0.3.312 cannot do it. View: the public Query type has no listPermissionRules; list_permission_rules is only an undeclared control request (sdk.d.ts:4872, not in the exported union's surface) and the runtime method listPermissionRules exists only in sdk.mjs, untyped. Edit: updateSettings accepts only localSettings.outputStyle and userSettings.effortLevel, no permissions, no deletion (sdk.d.ts:3038-3049). applyFlagSettings({permissions}) only writes the session flag layer (sdk.d.ts:3007-3013): rules added there list as source flagSettings, editability readonly (sdk.d.ts:5834-5845), and it cannot remove a rule saved in a settings file. PermissionUpdate removeRules/replaceRules exist only as a canUseTool answer during a prompt (sdk.d.ts:2604-2618). Revisit when Query exposes listPermissionRules and a rule-editing call.
